verdict.rationale: SerpApi has extensive documentation pages with parameter descriptions and code snippets (e.g., Python examples, script builder mentioned in serpapi-gh-7) and markdown-formatted docs for LLMs, but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (e.g., a live 'try it' console or Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) — the openapi probe returned 404s across all candidate paths. missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API console/playground with runnable requests, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent confirmation that examples can be executed directly from the docs.
